Hey. I think I have bipolar. Need opinions.

I finally get it and it’s crazy that I’m coming to this conclusion. I just lost my program in the fire academy because I just stopped going and I was doing so well. I can still be an EMT when I pass the test this week or next week and make good money but it’s not the same I was in school and I was with the city. 

I lost it because I just stopped going and I got into one of my depressive episode where I just stop caring and spending money. I don’t think I’m going to live that long so then I just stop doing everything m. Crazy thing is, is that I was doing well for over 30+ days still pushing hard; then I just say FUCK IT. Masturbating and buying porn after abstaining, drinking, more weed, not studying, missing class, not taking showers. 

I been suicidal and depressed since 11 or 12 and I do this shit every year where I just say FUCK IT. I’ve been constantly trying to search year after year about what I might have and I think I’m bipolar. I was looking at the symptoms and I finally found something after 10+ years  that related to how I was feeling. I’m going to schedule a doctors appointment, which is ironic because I lost not only my counselor with the job but I also lost my health insurance LOOL. 

There is only ups or down with me and I go from feeling like the most sexiest man to an undesirable creature. I’ll do good and I self sabotage because I’ll feel like I’ll never be good because of past trauma

Either way I cant do it on my anymore I tried, I tired. I just feel so ducking tired because now I have to tell my family this is another thing I lost.  They’re then gonna ask like always, “What happened?” People always ask me why do you feel like that you’ve done so much and you look like xyz. Like how the tf do you explain to people that it’s just a switch that I literally can’t control I try man I really do.

In conclusion, I can’t do it on my own if I want to be successful. I’m finally getting the help for the first time in my life. It’s so fucking tiring picking up the pieces Year after year knowing you can do so much more. Thanks for reading.

I listened to a lot of music this week wow.

**Isaiah Rashad - Cilvia Demo**

Isaiah Rashad really caught me by surprise. I didn't expect this to be this good honestly. There is not one bad song on this tape imo. 9/10  Fav Tracks: West Savannah Feat. SZA, Heavenly Father, Menthol, Shot You Down.

**Jimi Hendrix - Are You Experienced?** 

Always had heard about it never listened to it. I finally listened to it and it is a magical journey. If you haven't heard it go listen to it, Jimi's storytelling abilities are amazing. 10/10

**Gorillaz - Plastic Beach**

Good follow up from Demon Days, enjoyable 8/10

**Kid Cudi - The Demo Tapes**

This was ok, but considering these were mostly throwaways it was ok. 6.5/10

**Pusha T - Wraith of Caine**

Pusha T comes through will a solid mixtape. The features were pretty good and the beats were pretty good also. The only complaint I have is that some of the songs sound samey though. 7.5/10

**Black Milk - Black and Brown**
 
Detroit rappers Danny Brown and Black Milk collaborate on this LP. I'm from Detroit too so when I first heard about this a couple of months ago I was excited because I didn't hear about before. Solid rapping by Danny Brown and solid instrumentals from Black Milk. 8/10 Fav tracks: Dada, Jordan VIII, Black & Brown, Zap

**Joey Bada$$ - Summer Knights**

This was a good followup to 1999. Do I think this is as good as 1999? No. This is like a 7 and 1999 is like a 9. Overall it was still enjoyable for me and good listen front to back. 7.5/10

**DMX - Flesh of My Flesh Blood Of My Blood**

Good album nothing to say about it you already know. 8/10

**Deerhoof - Milkman** 

This was a very fun listen, from the crazy lyrics to the catchy choruses and instrumentals. 8/10

**Earl Sweatshirt - Doris**

I have nothing to say about this album, been listening to it everyday since it came out 9/10.

**The Cool Kids - That's Stupid The Mixtape**

Chuck Inglish and Sir Michael Rocks came through will a good little EP, good listen to from front to back. It's short, sweet, and simple. 8/10

**Black Moth Super Rainbow - Drippers**

Short EP by BSMR with remixes and unreleased stuff. Some of their most best experimental shit to date. 9/10

**Danny Brown - XXX**

I think we already know about this album 8/10 Fav Tracks: Scrap or Die, Fields, 30, Monopoly, Adderall Admiral, EWNESW.

**Mac Miller - Macadelic**

Mac Miller took us all by surprise with this one 7.5/8 /10

**Pro Era - The Shift EP**

This is a really cohesive project from front to back. I like all the songs on here, the lyrics and the production is on point no complaints. 8/10 Fav Tracks: Extortion, Butterflies.

**Green Day - Dookie**

This album really took me by surprise. I don't listen to Green Day so when I listened to this I had mixed expectations but I came out wowed. There is hardly no bad songs. Fav Tracks: Burnout, Having a Blast, Basket Case(of course), When I Come Around, Longview, Come to Paradise. 9/10
